'''TC-72''' was a [[TC-series protocol droid/Legends|TC-series protocol droid]] in the employ of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. She once was assigned to the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] on a voyage to [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] did not ingratiate herself to Solo, but was instrumental in the negotiations.

==Biography==
During the reign of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], TC-72 worked for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal empire]]. The crime leader Jabba the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] sent his two favorite [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] to [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]] to pick up more guards. Their primary point of contact was a [[Unidentified Gamorrean farmer|Gamorrean farmer]], and they required a translator to negotiate. Solo refused to work with a [[Droid/Legends|droid]], but Jabba blackmailed him by threatening to give the contract to [[BoShek/Legends|BoShek]]. Solo agreed and the three boarded his ship, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. During the transit in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], TC-72 did not ingrain herself to the smuggler by her refusal to cease talking. Eventually, Solo taped her [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]] shut and shut her in the cargo bay.

When the smugglers landed, Solo removed the tape from her vocabulator so she could negotiate with their contact. Solo made the mistake of assuming the farmer was male, and insulted her. She was about to kill him when TC-72 apologized on behalf of the uncouth smuggler. After more negotiations, the two smugglers departed with the guards and a package of [[Snoruuk/Legends|snoruuks]].

==Personality and traits==
TC-72 was officious and tended to talk too much, to the chagrin of those around her.

==Behind the scenes==
TC-72 was a minor character created for [[Ryder Windham]]'s [[2010]] young-reader novel ''[[Adventures in Hyperspace: Shinbone Showdown]]''.
